sentences.text: Patna High Court CWJC No.20551 of 2025(2) dt.06-01-2026 2.

The petitioner in paragraph no. 1 of the present writ petition has sought inter alia the following relief(s), which is reproduced hereinafter:-
"1. That this is an application for issuance of a proper writ or writs, direction or directions, order or orders to the respondents not to construct Automatic Block Signal Relay Room (herein after called ABS Room) over the petitioner's purchased land through registered Sale-deed situated at Village- Shivnar, Thana No. 31, Khata No. 1067, Khesra No. 1779, Area 45 decimal registered in the name of Late Ajnasho Devi, who is mother-in-law of the petitioner.

For a further direction to restrain the respondents from constructing Automatic Block Signal Relay Room over the petitioner's purchased land that too without any proper acquisition and without paying compensation to the petitioner."
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioner submitted that the petitioner claims that he is in possession of plot nos.1781 and 1779 (detailed in para-12 to the writ petition) having a constructed structure over the said piece of land.
The petitioner is aggrieved by the demolition of structure and destruction of the crops grown over the said land, as a result of illegal act of the contractor of the Indian railways.

4. He further submitted that the contractor of the Indian railways had informed him that the alleged demolition has been done for construction of Automatic Block Signal Relay Room (hereinafter referred to as the 'ABS Room') over the petitioner's land.

It is the case of the petitioner that before taking Patna High Court CWJC No.20551 of 2025(2) dt.06-01-2026 such an extreme action, no notices were served to him nor any notice was published in the newspaper in respect of acquisition of the land belonging to the petitioner, which calls for interference of this Court.

5. Considering the aforesaid information, it appears that even the petitioner was not ignorant about any steps taken for acquisition of the land belonging to the petitioner rather he was not informed about the action taken by the authority concerned, requires interference of this Court.

6. I find it proper to direct the General Manager, East Central Railway, Hajipur, Vaishali; the Principal Chief Engineer, East Central Railway, Hajipur, Vaishali and the District Collector, Patna to see whether the land of the petitioner has been acquired, if acquired the same is in accordance with law.

In case the land of the petitioner has been acquired in accordance with law then the petitioner is required to be duly compensated for the area, which has been acquired for the purpose of construction of ABS Room over his land.
7. The petitioner, if so advised, may also file a detailed representation before the competent authorities concerned.

The authorities concerned, in that case, are directed to dispose of the representation filed on behalf of the petitioner, Patna High Court CWJC No.20551 of 2025(2)
dt.06-01-2026 in accordance with law, expeditiously.
